$comment: The gauntlet ledger. Seeded from GAUNTLET.md; every critic round appends here (bump rounds, replace verdict/verdictAt, set the factual checks, add shot filenames under tools/progress/shots/). Nothing in here is generated - build-progress.mjs only reads it. Pieces that feed the same rubric row MUST spell "criterion" identically: the summary counts each distinct criterion string once, so a typo turns the 100-point rubric into a 140-point one. status: todo | building | gauntlet | capped | done. checks: pass | fail | pending | n/a. roundCap null means the piece escalates instead of capping (the two first-class pieces).
project: After Dark — Devoxx Belgium Robot Games

pieces.title: Scaffold and sim contract
pieces.note: pnpm + Vite + TS strict + vitest + three. types.ts / constants.ts / units.ts are frozen: every other piece codes against them. No visual surface, so no critic round.

pieces.title: Floor-plan fidelity
pieces.note: Top-down debug screenshot overlaid on plans/devoxx-rooms-stairs-annotated.png and plans/exhibition-floor-stairs-annotated.png. Room count, proportions, door positions and BOTH staircase positions (3|4, 10|9, main between 6 and 7) must match before any aesthetic judgment. Orange Zaal numeral panels and the blue Dutch wayfinding signs must be visible in-scene.

pieces.title: Robot appearance fidelity
pieces.note: Each robot posed at an angle showing face and front — never top-down — beside robots/*.png. Silhouette, proportions, palette and the signature details. A robot that reads as a generic humanoid fails however well it animates.

pieces.title: Sim physics and prototype parity
pieces.note: Frozen constants asserted by tests/frozen-constants.test.ts. Acceptance is the ported prototype choreography: jammed door breaks for Biggy alone at ~103 px/s and never below 70, roller door fails solo and breaks at ~282 when Voxxy pushes, cable 1270–1311 px straight and over 1480 on the lane route.

pieces.title: Per-robot animation and idle personality
pieces.note: Walk, run, squeeze, reach, force-fix and the 'nope' bounce, anchored on the organisers' motion numbers in docs/organisers-3d-demo-notes.md. Planted feet and coordinated arm swing; weight readable per robot.

pieces.title: Light, shadow and fog of war
pieces.criterion: Originality — genre, mechanic, reading of the brief
pieces.note: Visibility polygons per lamp, additive colour mixing, glass and low obstacles passing light, the cinema screen as a mirror, explored-darkness mask. This is the game's mechanic — it carries most of the 40 originality points.

pieces.title: Cutscenes and chapter transitions
pieces.criterion: Originality — genre, mechanic, reading of the brief
pieces.note: gather → walk the waypoints → fade → next chapter, with the staircase walks between floors. Skip must work mid-cutscene.

pieces.title: HUD, feedback and 'why am I blocked'
pieces.note: Every gate wall explains itself in the blocked robot's own voice, throttled 2.5 s per wall. Objective line, robot switcher, skip button.

pieces.title: Audio synthesised in code
pieces.criterion: Originality — genre, mechanic, reading of the brief
pieces.note: Per-robot footsteps, fix chime, nope buzz, ambient hum, victory fanfare. WebAudio only — no asset files anywhere in the repo.

pieces.title: Devoxx flavour beats
pieces.note: Tomato soup, the queues, the OutOfMemoryError beer joke, Stephan at the gate, the keynote speaker still listed as TBA. Nothing that needs permission.

pieces.title: Full-run stability pass
pieces.note: Four chapters end to end with zero console errors, at a steady frame rate, including every skip path.

pieces.title: Integration playthrough
pieces.note: After each build wave a fresh agent plays all four chapters and smooths the seams the parallel builders left. Nothing ships without at least one clean full run.

pieces.title: README, GenAI notes and submission
pieces.note: README that runs from a fresh clone, an entry in docs/genai-notes.md per session, MIT licence check, submission form. The last ~36 h are reserved for this.
